title: NEET 2020 Question Paper PDF with Chapter-wise Analysis
excerpt: NEET 2020 question paper PDF with a subject-wise, chapter-wise analysis of Physics, Chemistry, Botany and Zoology: 196 tagged questions mapped to NCERT chapters.
bodyMarkdown:
Download the **NEET 2020 question paper PDF** from the attachment box on this page (log in to download), then read the chapter-wise analysis below. It shows which chapters and topics each subject drew from, and how that compares with the previous paper.

:::tip NEET 2020 at a glance
- **Physics:** 46 questions
- **Chemistry:** 61 questions
- **Botany:** 44 questions
- **Zoology:** 45 questions
- **Tagged total:** 196
:::
